strings.title: The Night of the Swapped Painting
strings.hint: Look for the skill before the opportunity. A copy this convincing takes months to create. Who knew the maintenance date months in advance?
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: Anis Hallaq, the art restorer.

He was the only person in the circle capable of producing a copy that could fool the naked eye, and the only one who knew about the maintenance window three months ahead, from the meeting where he attended as a consultant and the schedule was approved. He painted the copy at leisure in his studio, entered legally on maintenance night, and left with the original rolled inside a metal drawing tube that nobody inspected.

The evidence against him: fibers from the copy's canvas in his studio, a match to the custom varnish, and his double entry record. He entered once as the restorer and again with a forged subcontractor permit to move the tube.
strings.summary.text: A week after routine overnight maintenance at the National Museum, the curator noticed that 'Dawn of the City' — an icon of the east gallery for a century — reflected light incorrectly. Examination confirmed the disaster: an exceptionally skilled copy was on display, and the original had disappeared on a night when the cameras were off 'under maintenance protocol.' There had been no break-in. The thief walked through the door with a permit.

strings.scene.address: National Museum — east gallery and service corridor
strings.scene.intro: No damage or disturbance. The frame was removed with professional screwdrivers and reassembled with a restorer's care. The copy was painted on artificially aged canvas with a custom varnish unavailable off the shelf. Months of preparation, carried out in hours.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: The gallery after the substitution was discovered
strings.scene.notes[0]: Cameras off under scheduled maintenance protocol
strings.scene.notes[1]: Frame removed and reassembled with professional restoration tools
strings.scene.notes[2]: Copy on artificially aged canvas with custom varnish
strings.scene.notes[3]: Two entry permits that night: restorer and subcontractor
strings.evidence[0].title: Forged painting
strings.evidence[0].desc: An exceptionally skilled copy. Despite artificial aging, the paint is only a few months old.
strings.evidence[1].title: Night entry permit register
strings.evidence[1].desc: A subcontractor permit bearing a genuine stamp but issued to a nonexistent company.
strings.evidence[2].title: Drawing tube
strings.evidence[2].desc: The restorer left carrying a metal tube 130 cm long, wide enough to hold the rolled painting.
strings.evidence[3].title: Varnish sample
strings.evidence[3].desc: A custom varnish blend in unusual proportions — a professional restoration workshop's recipe.
strings.evidence[4].title: Approved maintenance schedule
strings.evidence[4].desc: Approved at a closed meeting 3 months earlier. The attendance list contains 5 names.
strings.evidence[5].title: Guard's switched-off monitor
strings.evidence[5].desc: The guard turned off the internal surveillance monitor for 40 minutes. He says he fell asleep.
strings.suspects[0].name: Dr. Salwa Marei
strings.suspects[0].alibi: 'I left before maintenance and returned in the morning — my access card proves it.'
strings.suspects[0].statement: I discovered the substitution and reported it. If I'd done it, I wouldn't have alerted anyone; the copy could have hung there for twenty years. Check who attended the scheduling meeting. That's where the information leaked.
strings.suspects[1].name: Anis Hallaq
strings.suspects[1].alibi: 'I came that night to inspect damp in the east wall — work documented by my permit.'
strings.suspects[1].statement: These hands restored half this museum's treasures. Your suspicion wounds a lifetime of work. Yes, I know every centimeter of that painting. That is precisely why I can tell you that whoever painted this copy is a genius… and as obsessed with it as I am.
strings.suspects[2].name: Mansour, the guard
strings.suspects[2].relation: Responsible for the surveillance monitors that night
strings.suspects[2].alibi: 'I fell asleep for forty minutes. I admit negligence, not theft.'
strings.suspects[2].statement: My salary wouldn't buy the frame, so how would I sell the painting? I switched off the monitor because it was shining in my eyes, then fell asleep. I'll answer for that mistake. But the gate register works without my involvement. Look for whoever entered twice.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Maintenance supervisor
strings.witnesses[0].statement: The restorer asked to work alone in the east wing because of 'humidity sensitivity.' He kept my workers away for two full hours.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Gate clerk
strings.witnesses[1].statement: The subcontractor permit arrived in an official internal envelope the day before. The stamp was genuine, but I didn't see a representative deliver it as usual.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Student at a neighboring studio
strings.witnesses[2].statement: All winter, Mr. Anis kept his studio closed for a 'private project.' Once, I glimpsed a large canvas almost the size of a door.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Substitution report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: An official report from the curator following examination of light reflection and preliminary laboratory confirmation.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Copy examination report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Artificially aged canvas and custom-blended varnish. Estimated production time: 3–4 months, by a professional restorer rather than an ordinary painter.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Frame examination report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: Removed and reassembled with precision restoration tools. The frame screws were numbered in a professional restorer's sequence.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Curator's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Consistent. Her access card was not used on maintenance night. She supplied the scheduling meeting's attendance list.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Restorer's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: He said the tube held 'damp survey plans.' He refused a studio search without a warrant; a warrant was obtained.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Guard's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: He admitted sleeping on duty. His phone examination confirms 40 minutes of inactivity.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Double entry record
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: The signature on the contractor permit matches the slant of the restorer's handwriting. The two entries were 95 minutes apart.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Workshop purchase records
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: Aged hemp canvas and twentieth-century pigments were purchased from European suppliers under Anis's workshop name during the winter.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Studio search report
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: Fibers from the copy's canvas, the same varnish recipe, and preparatory sketches showing the painting's stages. The original was absent — already sold?
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Mysterious buyer's correspondence
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: An encrypted email specifies delivery at a nearby port for 'a figure with seven zeros.' Recovery is underway through international coordination.
strings.reports[0].title: Reconstruction of the night
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: A first, authorized entry to position the copy behind the curtain; a second entry with a forged permit to remove the original in the tube. For someone who had rehearsed for months, 95 minutes was enough.
strings.reports[1].title: Skill and motive assessment
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: The skill required narrows the field to professional restorers. The workshop's debts and the restorer's unhealthy obsession with the painting complete the picture.
strings.notes[0].text: The copy took months — the crime began long before that night
strings.notes[1].text: Who entered twice in one night?
